text:
olivia: Thinking aloud — what if we add a 'quick mode' to the deploy bot that does three things: 1) auto-generates a compact release digest from PR titles, 2) enforces change-window via calendar check, and 3) offers a single-line rollback capture for incidents. Low-friction for daily pushes.

sam: +1. Love the autogen digest. Can we make it optional per-deploy? e.g. `/deploy quick --digest=auto|none`

deploy-bot: Proposed command prototype:
```
/deploy quick --service=api --env=staging --digest=auto --calendar=team-releases --pin=auto-minor
# returns a 3-line summary + buttons: Confirm | Edit notes | Abort
```

mike: Calendar enforcement — how strict? Block outside change windows or just warn? If block, need an escape-hatch for emergency patches.

annika: My vote: block by default, allow a two-factor override: `/deploy quick --override --reason="emergency db migration"` that logs a mandatory field. Helps audits.

release-eng: For the digest, can we include a tiny quality tag per PR (perf/regression risk) from our CI labels so SRE knows if rollout needs a longer burn?

olivia: Yes. Digest should be compact: 3 bullets, risk tags, and a short rollout plan. Minimal noise in the channel. Example output idea below.

deploy-bot: Example autogen digest output (bot message):
---
Release digest (api @staging)
- Add health-check backoff (PR #3421) [low-risk]
- Fix token cache eviction (PR #3428) [medium-risk] :eyes:
- Bump deps (PR #3430) [low-risk]
Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% (30m between steps)
Change window: verified (team-releases calendar) :calendar:
Buttons: [Confirm] [Edit notes] [Abort]
---

sam: If Confirm is clicked, bot should post a pinned release note to a repo file and make a tiny release entry in the internal changelog: `releases/YYYY-MM-DD-api.md`. Auto-commit with author `deploy-bot` and include the captured override reason if any.

annika: Capture rollback rationale too. In the case of a rollback, require a short structured line: `rollback: root-cause-keyword | duration | immediate-action`. Bot should append this to the release entry for audit.

mike: How about quick-mode telemetry? Bot should attach a links bundle with: rollout metrics dashboard, latency summary, and a one-click rollback command.

deploy-bot: Example quick rollback snippet (one-line):
`/deploy rollback --service=api --to-revision=2025-03-11_abcdef --reason="latency spike"`
Bot auto-opens a small form if `--reason` is omitted.

olivia: Minimal templates for ops to copy into our playbooks: small code snippet for autogen notes below. This is intentionally tiny; the heavy lifting remains in our release generator.

```bash
# autogen-release-notes.sh (very compact)
git fetch origin main
git log --pretty=format:'- %s (PR #%h by %an)' origin/main..HEAD --no-merges | head -n 10 > /tmp/RELEASE_DIGEST.md
# append CI risk labels if present (simple grep on PR body)
```

sam: UX note — editing the digest inline should allow quick free-text with a max 3-line summary; keep buttons small. Integrate with existing release templates but default to the short digest.

annika: Security note — overrides must be scoped to a role (release-approver). Enforce via SSO group check before accepting `--override`.

release-eng: Ops checklist to pair with quick mode: health-check endpoints, circuit-breaker thresholds, and a smoke-test runbook (2 commands). We can store the checklist as a small YAML snippet surfaced by the bot.

olivia: One last thing — change-window calendar mapping: `team-releases` -> oncall + approver list. If outside window, bot shows approvers and requires one to `:thumbsup:` to proceed.

mike: Sounds good. I'll prototype the override flow and a tiny mock of the digest UI this week.

sam: I'll draft the minimal release template and the autogen script improvements.

annika: I'll write the SSO group enforcement and the rollback-capture shape for audits.

olivia: Great — thanks all. Can we sync Tues to review prototype? :calendar:
